source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes the case label is an exact sensor name and truncates its SDR fallback at 100 lines while calling it FULL; it omits stable identity, WebUI, spec, unit/scaling/threshold/freshness and safe Script review.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION keeps this row read-only and requires exact sensor/SDR identity, specification and UI/OOB correlation.

old_problem: The label was treated as a literal sensor name without proving the Dashboard/Server Health row maps to the same stable record. Expected reading/state, units, scaling, thresholds, hysteresis, freshness and unavailable semantics were missing, fallback was truncated, and the internal Script was unpinned.
disposition_reason: The source clearly asks for a read-only UI reading/threshold/spec comparison. Resolve the exact sensor through stable SDR/API identity, bind Project expected fields and freshness/tolerance, collect complete OOB plus both UI views and compare canonical values. The similarly titled dynamic row remains separate; no stimulus, threshold write, SEL fill or clear is invented. Exact mapping/spec/Script revision are execution prerequisites.
decision_basis: XLSX row 869, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, separate dynamic-row precedent, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
Sensor evidence is meaningful only when identity, units/scaling, analog/discrete semantics, threshold availability and freshness refer to the same record.
Dashboard and Server Health can round/cache the same backend differently, so approved normalization and timestamps are required rather than literal-text equality.
ED-15 requires an approved specification; ED-17 rejects unrelated clearing; ED-20 preserves both UI views; ED-35 prevents static evidence from claiming dynamic stimulus coverage.

test_case.test_name: Correlate the exact SEL_RealErr_Full sensor across Dashboard, Server Health and authoritative OOB data
test_case.purpose: Verify the Sensor Page representation associated with `SEL_RealErr_Full` is human readable and that the uniquely mapped sensor's current analog reading or discrete state, applicable warning/critical thresholds, units, health/status and freshness agree with the platform specification and authoritative OOB record across Dashboard and Server Health.
required_package: Exact BMC/chassis, firmware/WebUI build, SDR repository revision, role and trusted endpoint identity
Stable case-label-to-sensor mapping using sensor ID/name/number/type/entity/instance and corresponding Dashboard/Server Health row identifiers
Project expected reading or state, units, conversion/scaling/rounding, tolerance, status and lower/upper noncritical/critical/nonrecoverable thresholds where applicable
Rules for analog versus discrete sensors, missing/unavailable thresholds, hysteresis, assertion state, disabled/not-readable values, cache age and stale timestamps
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser versions and supported authentication/transport
Pinned immutable accessible `sensor.git` revision/checksum/content/dependency safety review, or an approved manual read-only collection method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs or mutate sensors. Bind the case label to exactly one stable SDR/API identity; stop on zero, duplicate or substring-only matches. If the internal Script is used, first pin and review its exact revision for target, reads/writes, clears, secrets and retries. Capture BMC time and the complete exact OOB record including ID/type/entity, analog reading or discrete state, units/scaling, all applicable thresholds/hysteresis, status and timestamp without `head`, `tail` or fallback truncation. Capture the same sensor in Dashboard and Server Health with refresh timestamps. Normalize only by approved conversion/rounding and compare identity, value/state, units, thresholds, status and freshness with Project SPEC. Reread to prove no mutation; never change thresholds, acknowledge/inject faults, heat/cool hardware, fill SEL or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: One unique mapped sensor appears human readably in both Dashboard and Server Health. Each UI representation and the complete OOB record agree within approved scaling/rounding/freshness rules on identity, analog reading or discrete state, units, applicable threshold/hysteresis fields and status, and all fields match Project SPEC. Absent/NA/disabled thresholds are accepted only under the signed sensor-type rule. No log, threshold or sensor state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires unique stable sensor mapping, complete nontruncated OOB evidence, both UI views, approved expected matrix and field-level identity/value/state/unit/threshold/status/freshness agreement with engineer verdict. A literal-name query, readable number, truncated SDR list or one UI view cannot pass. Missing/duplicate identity, unsupported units/scaling, stale value, unexplained UI/OOB/spec mismatch or unexpected mutation is FAIL. Missing mapping, expected matrix or reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. No dynamic error/SEL-full coverage is claimed.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL/dmesg/system logs; clearing is unrelated to read-only sensor validation and destroys diagnostic context.
Do not assume `SEL_RealErr_Full` is the literal SDR name or choose a substring; bind stable identity/type/entity metadata.
Do not use `head -100`, tail or terminal truncation; capture the complete exact record and command/status evidence.
Do not change thresholds, acknowledge faults, inject sensor states, heat/cool hardware or fill SEL; those require separate approved cases.
Do not expose passwords, assume cipher 17 or run the Script before immutable safety review.
Stop without retry on identity/unit/scaling ambiguity, stale/unavailable values, mismatch beyond tolerance, unexpected mutation or BMC instability.
expected_evidence: BMC/chassis, firmware/WebUI/SDR identity, role/trusted access and exact case-label-to-sensor/UI mapping
Complete raw SDR/API record with stable identity, value/state, units/scaling, thresholds/hysteresis/status and timestamp
Dashboard and Server Health route/DOM/screenshots with refresh time and the same stable sensor identity
Approved Project expected matrix and normalized field comparison including tolerance and absent/NA/stale rules
Pinned Script revision/checksum/content review or signed alternate method and protected command audit
Before/after no-clear/no-write proof, mismatch/limitation report, BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On ambiguous identity, mismatch or unexpected state change, stop and preserve first evidence; use the approved OOB/vendor diagnostic path without changing thresholds or forcing a fault. If the Script mutates anything unexpectedly, isolate it, record the action and have the authorized owner restore the prior state from the captured baseline.
